result.title: Vasicek Diffusion Bridge for Graph Generation
result.summary: Diffusion-based graph generation models progressively transform Gaussian noise into structured graphs through stochastic dynamics. We observe that the effectiveness of this transformation is fundamentally determined by the evolution of the diffusion trajectory. Existing graph diffusion models often suffer from excessive uncertainty during diffusion and delayed growth of the signal-to-noise ratio, causing useful structural information to emerge only in the later stages of generation. To address this issue, we propose the Vasicek Graph Diffusion (VGD), a graph diffusion process derived from the Vasicek dynamics. The key insight of VGD is data-anchored mean dynamics with a closed-form solution, which analytically establishes a continuous transition from Gaussian noise to the target graph distribution. Unlike conventional graph diffusion processes that rely predominantly on stochastic evolution, VGD introduces a data-anchored drift that continuously steers the latent state toward the target distribution throughout diffusion. As a consequence, VGD maintains a smoothly evolving uncertainty while rapidly increasing the signal-to-noise ratio throughout diffusion, allowing informative graph structures to emerge much earlier during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple graph generation benchmarks demonstrate that VGD outperforms existing diffusion-based graph generative models in terms of generation quality and structural fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Vasicek Graph Diffusion：借助 Vasicek 动力学得到带数据锚定漂移、有闭式解的图扩散过程，使潜状态在整个扩散中持续被拉向目标图分布，从而在保持不确定性平滑变化的同时快速提升信噪比，并在多个图生成基准上验证生成质量与结构保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「数据锚定漂移+闭式解」的潜状态轨迹设计与信噪比/不确定性演化控制，可供核查 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成中如何持续引导状态、让有效信息更早出现；但研究对象是纯图生成，与视觉推理证据无直接联系。
